title: DeepTutor: Your AI Tutor for Life
verify_before_render: Stars, license, and repo status re-checked against the live repo on render day.

scenes.heading: A TUTOR THAT *LEARS WITH YOU* FOREVER
scenes.say: Most AI tutors forget you after one session. DeepTutor is built to learn alongside you for years.

scenes.heading: DeepTutor
scenes.say: It's called DeepTutor. It's a multi-agent system that personalizes education to how you learn, not just what you know.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Multiple AI agents work together. One tracks your knowledge. Another adapts the difficulty. A third checks your understanding. They coordinate to give you a tutor that actually knows your level.

scenes.heading: 48,105 ★ AND GROWING
scenes.say: Forty eight thousand stars. Two thousand more today. The education AI space is exploding, and DeepTutor is leading it.

scenes.heading: TRY IT FREE
scenes.say: It's open source and self-hostable. Run it locally, or deploy it to your own server. Your data never leaves your machine.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: No AI tutor replaces a real teacher. But DeepTutor's multi-agent approach gets closer than anything I've seen. It adapts, it remembers, and it pushes you when you're ready.
What would you want a lifetime AI tutor to teach you? Comment TUTOR and follow for tools like this.
